description: Our syntax-link model (Table XII, column 'Ours'), its direction classifier, candidates and selection.

candidates.distance: box gap (0 for touching or overlapping boxes)
candidates.rule: union of both endpoints' neighbour lists

architecture.cnn_input: two box masks; page channel empty; features averaged over both mask orders

direction_classifier.inputs: one-hot endpoint classes and 15 standardized geometric features

selection.threshold: maximum pooled validation micro-F1; ties broken by recall, then by the larger threshold
